race.description: Rmbl Investments Rising Stars Race Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: ALMAGO (8) showed early speed from an outside draw and held a forward position before fading to finish fifth, beaten 4.5 lengths, when returning after a spell last start over 1746m at Sale. This is a sight easier than that, and a number of races she contested last prep, so she looks a major player with an in-form rider up. SQUARE DEAL (1) turned things around last start and scored by 3/4 of a length over 1400m at Echuca. Finds a suitable race and can make it back-to-back wins. BANK HEIST (3), who broke the maiden here last time and has been relatively consistent all preparation. MISS TRAMELL (10) wasn't too far off COUNT OF TOULOUSE last start and COUNT OF TOULOUSE would have been one of the leading fancies here if not scratched.
